ftb.guhs_dromen.title: &dGuh Dreamland
ftb.guhs_dromen.sub: Tuck your guh in, and dream along
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.intro_guhs_dromen.desc:
This chapter can start right away, as soon as you have a tamed guh (&dGuh!&r in &dGuhs & basics&r).

Guhs get sleepy in the evening. Tuck your guh into a &6box of nibbles&r (or a kitty house, little bed or nest), go to sleep in a bed next to it, and you dream along: &dGuh Dreamland&r, floating islands above a lavender sea.

There the story of &dSnoes&r is waiting, the guh who can't sleep. Help him, and the wild &bBlub-guhs&r show themselves to you. Also: the &dWeather Vadser&r, sleepy things for at home and The Singing Meadow. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headers show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get vadsing!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_blub_vriend.title: A Blub as a friend
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_blub_vriend.desc: After Snoes' story you see wild &bBlub-guhs&r everywhere (mostly in the Singing Meadow). Tame one with a cheese nibble and pick it up: sneak + click. Every Blub has its own Blub-Guh-Meter!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_blub_badje.title: Bubble bath
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_blub_badje.desc: Make a &dBlub bubble bath&r. A Blub goes bathing in it by itself, and with the chore Bubble Bath Master your guhs get fresh and happy.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_blub_glas.title: Not empty yet!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_blub_glas.desc: Clutter Guh leaves glasses with a little bit left everywhere. Make a few yourself too: three glass panes in a V.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weer_vadser.title: Weather vadsing
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weer_vadser.desc: Make a &dWeather Vadser&r and set the weather within 60 blocks: sun, rain, snow or thunder. It wants 20 vadskracht while another weather is on. Then it even rains in the Guhmension!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weer_bellen.title: Bubble shower
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weer_bellen.desc: Find a &bweather jar: bubble shower&r (in the chests of the Guh Bubble and Bikini Bottom, or in the Cloud Bath of Guh Dreamland). Use it and switch it on in your Weather Vadser.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weer_regenboog.desc: The &drainbow weather&r: open the souvenir 'Rainbow in a jar', get gold on the Guh Circuit, or help Snoes sleep.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_doos.title: A guh always picks the box
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_doos.desc: Make a &6box of nibbles&r. In the evening you tuck your guh into it (right-click), and at night guhs crawl in by themselves.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_kattenhuisje.title: Kitty house
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_kattenhuisje.desc: A &dkitty house&r in pink, white, lavender or mint. Very pretty. (The box wins anyway.)
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_muziekdoosje.title: Lullaby
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_muziekdoosje.desc: With a &dmusic box&r you softly sing the guhs nearby to sleep.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_mobiel.title: Spin, mobile, spin
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_mobiel.desc: Hang a &dmobile&r above the guh bed: it spins and plays a song.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_maanlampje.title: Night light
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_maanlampje.desc: A &dmoon night light&r for the guh room: click on, click off.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_krabpaal.title: Scratching post
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_krabpaal.desc: Tamed guhs hop onto a &dscratching post&r in the daytime and sit there proudly.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_droomland.title: Guh Dreamland
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_droomland.desc: In the evening tuck your guh in (box, kitty house, little bed or nest) and go to sleep in a bed next to it. What you give it decides on which island you start. Waking up: your &ddream pillow&r or the Alarm Guh.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_droomzand.title: Dream sand
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_droomzand.desc: In Guh Dreamland you find &ddream sand&r. You make dream blocks with it.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_zeepbelglas.title: Bubble glass
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_zeepbelglas.desc: Glass with shifting rainbow colours: 8 glass and 1 dream sand.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_slaapliedjesgras.de: &dLullaby grass&r hums softly when you walk over it.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_proloog.title: Who is sitting by your bed?
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_proloog.desc: Do you have a tamed guh? Then click your bed in the evening. Somebody is sitting next to it... Talk to him, tuck him in, and go to sleep yourself.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_liedje.title: The song
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_liedje.desc: On the &dLullaby Hills&r the wild Blubs are shy. Bring them to their bell hill, and together they squeak Snoes' lullaby.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_ster.title: The falling star
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_ster.desc: Bounce over the giant pillows of the &eStar Cushion Field&r, higher and higher, and catch the falling star. Watch out for the pillow fight guhs!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_herinnering.d: On &6Memory Island&r touch the three memory bubbles: a cheese nibble, a Blub and the stars. What does Snoes remember from long ago?
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_bad.title: The bath
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_bad.desc: Float in soap bubbles past the clouds of the &bCloud Bath&r and fetch the bath things. Snoes' first bubble bath ever!
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_droomzand.des: The mill of the &7Moon Mill&r stands still. Blow the sails round with the Blubs and set the little cogs right, then the Sand Guh grinds dream sand.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_finale.title: Good night, Snoes
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_snoes_finale.desc: With all five pieces: back to the &dDream Square&r. Everybody comes to watch. Afterwards the wild Blub-guhs show themselves to you, and Bubbels comes home with you.
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weide.title: The Singing Meadow
ftb.guhs_dromen.q.dr_weide.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension lies a rare salmon-pink meadow with tall rock pillars, cloud trees and pools of bubble sap. The wild Blub-guhs live here. At dusk they sing together in the Choir Bowl.
